text:
Nico Hischier reached 501 career points on Nov. 8, at the net for a rebound in a 4-0 win in Toronto, as The Hockey News' Mike Fink noted. That made nine wins in New Jersey's last ten games, and the captain has been in the middle of it.

His numbers are steady more than spectacular: 8 goals and 13 points in 18 games, on 7.8 expected goals, so the finishing matches the chances. Seven of his points have come on the power play. The Devils take 61% of expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on.

If anything, he has been unlucky. New Jersey has scored 2.8 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and Evolving-Hockey had him producing well under his chances in 2025-26 too, while driving play (96th percentile among forwards) against top competition. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking notes 20% of his setups come from behind the net. Our range has him at 48 to 70 points.
headline: Hischier crosses 500 as the Devils keep winning
